entries.name: Cross-site Scripting (XSS)
entries.description: Improper neutralization of input during web page generation lets an attacker inject script that runs in the victim's browser.
entries.mitigation: Output-encode untrusted data per context (HTML body, attribute, JS, CSS, URL). Use template engines that auto-escape. Apply a strict CSP.

entries.name: Out-of-bounds Write
entries.description: Writing past the end (or before the start) of an allocated buffer corrupts adjacent memory.
entries.mitigation: Use length-checked APIs (strncpy_s, snprintf). Prefer modern languages with bounds checks. Run ASan/UBSan in CI.

entries.name: SQL Injection
entries.description: Concatenating untrusted input into SQL queries lets an attacker change the query's logic.
entries.mitigation: Use parameterised queries / prepared statements exclusively. ORM frameworks help. Never string-concatenate user input.

entries.name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
entries.description: An attacker tricks an authenticated browser into submitting a request the user did not intend.
entries.mitigation: Synchroniser tokens, SameSite=Lax/Strict cookies, double-submit cookies, custom request headers verified server-side.

entries.name: Path Traversal
entries.description: Accepting a path from untrusted input and resolving it without canonicalisation lets the attacker escape the intended directory.
entries.mitigation: Canonicalise (realpath / Path.resolve) and verify the result is inside an allow-listed root. Strip `..` segments after canonicalisation.

entries.name: Out-of-bounds Read
entries.description: Reading past the end (or before the start) of a buffer leaks memory contents to the attacker.
entries.mitigation: Length-check before each access. Use safer string functions. Run with sanitisers in tests.

entries.name: OS Command Injection
entries.description: Concatenating untrusted input into a shell command lets the attacker run arbitrary commands.
entries.mitigation: Use exec*-style APIs that take an argv list (not a shell string). Never invoke system()/popen(shell=True). If the shell is unavoidable, use vetted libraries that quote arguments.

entries.name: Use After Free
entries.description: Accessing memory after it has been freed produces undefined behaviour and is exploitable.
entries.mitigation: Use smart pointers (unique_ptr / shared_ptr / Rc / Arc). Modern Rust eliminates this entire class statically.

entries.name: Missing Authorisation
entries.description: An action is performed without checking the actor has the right to perform it.
entries.mitigation: Centralise authorisation. Decorate every endpoint with an explicit role/permission check. Default-deny.

entries.name: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
entries.description: Allowing users to upload files without restricting file type/content lets the attacker plant executable payloads on the server.
entries.mitigation: Restrict by content sniffing (not just MIME). Store outside the web root. Scan with AV. Re-encode media.

entries.name: Code Injection
entries.description: Untrusted input flows into eval / exec / Function() / template compile, letting the attacker run code in the host process.
entries.mitigation: Eliminate dynamic code evaluation entirely. Use safer alternatives (json.loads, ast.literal_eval, expression DSLs).

entries.name: Improper Input Validation
entries.description: The application receives input but does not validate it has the expected type, length, format, or range.
entries.mitigation: Allow-list validation per-field. Type coercion at the boundary. Reject early.

entries.name: Command Injection
entries.description: User input flows into a string passed to a command interpreter.
entries.mitigation: Argv-style APIs. Avoid shells. If unavoidable, use shlex.quote / pipes.quote — but prefer not to.

entries.name: Improper Authentication
entries.description: Weak or missing authentication lets the attacker impersonate other users.
entries.mitigation: Use vetted libraries (Passport, oauthlib, Devise). Hash passwords with Argon2/bcrypt. Rate-limit. MFA.

entries.name: Improper Privilege Management
entries.description: A process gains more privilege than required, or fails to drop privileges before handling untrusted data.
entries.mitigation: Drop privileges with seteuid / capabilities. Run untrusted handlers in a sandbox.

entries.name: Deserialisation of Untrusted Data
entries.description: Deserialising attacker-controlled input lets the attacker construct objects that execute code on instantiation (pickle.loads, yaml.load(unsafe), Java ObjectInputStream).
entries.mitigation: Use safe formats (JSON, MessagePack). When deserialising user input, validate type explicitly. yaml.safe_load instead of yaml.load.

entries.name: Information Exposure
entries.description: Sensitive information (stack trace, internal IP, version) is disclosed to an attacker.
entries.mitigation: Strip stack traces from production responses. Use generic error pages. Don't log secrets.

entries.name: Incorrect Authorisation
entries.description: The right authorisation check exists but is implemented incorrectly (off-by-one, wrong scope, wrong actor).
entries.mitigation: Test the negative path: unauthorised users must be rejected. Penetration test multi-tenant boundaries.

entries.name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
entries.description: The server fetches a URL the attacker controls; can reach internal endpoints (cloud metadata, internal admin services).
entries.mitigation: Allow-list outbound destinations. Block link-local + RFC1918 + cloud metadata IPs. Resolve hostnames yourself and recheck.

entries.name: Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer
entries.description: Generic memory-safety issue in C/C++.
entries.mitigation: Bounds checking, smart pointers, std::vector::at, AddressSanitizer in CI.

entries.name: NULL Pointer Dereference
entries.description: Dereferencing a null pointer crashes the process and can be a DoS vector.
entries.mitigation: Initialize pointers. Check return values. Use Optional<T>/std::optional.

entries.name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
entries.description: Credentials (passwords, API keys, tokens) embedded in source code.
entries.mitigation: Use a secrets manager (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager) or environment variables. Pre-commit hooks (gitleaks).

entries.name: Integer Overflow / Wraparound
entries.description: An arithmetic operation produces a value outside the type's range and wraps around.
entries.mitigation: Use checked arithmetic (i32::checked_add). UBSan in CI. Validate inputs before maths.

entries.name: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
entries.description: A request can cause unbounded CPU / memory / disk / network use.
entries.mitigation: Rate-limit. Set timeouts. Cap input size. Stream rather than buffer.

entries.name: Missing Authentication for Critical Function
entries.description: A privileged action can be invoked without authentication.
entries.mitigation: Require authentication on every endpoint by default. Don't trust local-only paths in cloud deployments.
